=Extract the data from the provided receipt image and format it into a strict JSON object.
Do not include Markdown formatting or conversational text. Use the following schema and rules:
Vendor:(string) The name of the store or merchant.
Date:(string) The date of the transaction converted to DD/MM/YYYY format.
Items:(string) Each item must be a single row formatted exactly as: name:<item name> -Qty:<quantity> -Total:<total price>,between the items have a newline
total:(Float) The grand total amount paid.
Strict formatting rule: Never use LaTeX or markdown escape codes such as \vert{}. Output plain text values only
